info.title: FinLover v1 API
info.description: Implemented operations only. Wallet create, list, detail, update and delete operations are available on v1. Monthly transaction reads are available; category lists, reports and current-user endpoints are not implemented. UI mock screens are not API integration.

post.description: Create a user with explicit privacy consent. confirmPassword must match password; password is limited to 72 UTF-8 bytes. Never returns passwordHash. Authorization takes precedence over cookie. Cookie writes require an Origin in PUBLIC_ORIGINS; missing Origin is rejected. Implemented.

400.description: Invalid JSON, fields, ID, or missing consent

403.description: Forbidden resource, system category, or untrusted/missing Origin for cookie writes

409.description: Duplicate email, category, or wallet name

post.description: Set HttpOnly session_token for seven days. Missing user and wrong password produce the same credentials error. Password is limited to 72 UTF-8 bytes. Authorization takes precedence over cookie. Cookie writes require an Origin in PUBLIC_ORIGINS; missing Origin is rejected. Implemented.

400.description: Invalid JSON, fields, ID, or missing consent

403.description: Forbidden resource, system category, or untrusted/missing Origin for cookie writes

post.description: Clear the cookie. Idempotent. Does not revoke previously issued JWTs. Authorization takes precedence over cookie. Cookie writes require an Origin in PUBLIC_ORIGINS; missing Origin is rejected. Implemented.

403.description: Forbidden resource, system category, or untrusted/missing Origin for cookie writes

delete.description: Permanently delete the authenticated user and cascade-delete their wallets, categories and transactions atomically. Session cookie only: any Authorization header, valid or not, is rejected with 401. No password re-authentication. Clears the session cookie, including when the account is already gone (404). Authorization takes precedence over cookie. Cookie writes require an Origin in PUBLIC_ORIGINS; missing Origin is rejected. Implemented.

403.description: Forbidden resource, system category, or untrusted/missing Origin for cookie writes

post.description: Create an owned custom category. Names are trimmed; duplicates conflict. Authorization takes precedence over cookie. Cookie writes require an Origin in PUBLIC_ORIGINS; missing Origin is rejected. Implemented.

400.description: Invalid JSON, fields, ID, or missing consent

403.description: Forbidden resource, system category, or untrusted/missing Origin for cookie writes

409.description: Duplicate email, category, or wallet name

put.description: Partial update of an owned non-system category. Authorization takes precedence over cookie. Cookie writes require an Origin in PUBLIC_ORIGINS; missing Origin is rejected. Implemented.

delete.description: Delete an owned non-system category and clear category references atomically. Transactions and wallet balances remain unchanged. Authorization takes precedence over cookie. Cookie writes require an Origin in PUBLIC_ORIGINS; missing Origin is rejected. Implemented.

400.description: Invalid JSON, fields, ID, or missing consent

403.description: Forbidden resource, system category, or untrusted/missing Origin for cookie writes

post.description: Create a wallet owned by the caller. Names are trimmed and unique per owner; unknown fields are stripped. There is no per-user wallet limit. Authorization takes precedence over cookie. Cookie writes require an Origin in PUBLIC_ORIGINS; missing Origin is rejected. Implemented.

403.description: Forbidden resource, system category, or untrusted/missing Origin for cookie writes

409.description: Duplicate email, category, or wallet name

get.description: List the authenticated user's wallets, with the default wallet first. Authorization takes precedence over cookie. Cookie-authenticated GETs do not require an Origin. Implemented.

Get an owned wallet by ID. Invalid IDs return 400; missing or another user's wallet returns 404. Authorization takes precedence over cookie. Cookie-authenticated GETs do not require an Origin. Implemented.

400.description: Invalid JSON, fields, ID, or missing consent

put.description: Partially update an owned wallet name or color. Balance, owner, and saving settings are not editable here. Authorization takes precedence over cookie. Cookie writes require an Origin in PUBLIC_ORIGINS; missing Origin is rejected. Implemented.

400.description: Invalid JSON, fields, ID, or missing consent

403.description: Forbidden resource, system category, or untrusted/missing Origin for cookie writes

409.description: Duplicate email, category, or wallet name

delete.description: Delete an owned wallet and all of its transactions atomically in one UnitOfWork; nothing is deleted if any step fails. Other wallets and their transactions are untouched. Any owned wallet may be deleted, including the default or last wallet. Data cannot be recovered. Authorization takes precedence over cookie. Cookie writes require an Origin in PUBLIC_ORIGINS; missing Origin is rejected. Implemented.

403.description: Forbidden resource, system category, or untrusted/missing Origin for cookie writes

get.description: List all owned transactions for an optional YYYY-MM month, defaulting to the current month in APPLICATION_TIMEZONE. Results are newest first; this monthly endpoint intentionally has no pagination. Authorization takes precedence over cookie. Cookie-authenticated GETs do not require an Origin. Implemented.

400.description: Invalid JSON, fields, ID, or missing consent

post.description: Create an owned transaction and adjust wallet balance in one MongoDB transaction. Requires a replica set. Category must belong to the user and match the transaction type. Persisted minimum amount is 0.01. Authorization takes precedence over cookie. Cookie writes require an Origin in PUBLIC_ORIGINS; missing Origin is rejected. Implemented.

put.description: Replace editable fields of an owned transaction; reverse old and apply new balance atomically. wallet cannot be changed by this API. Authorization takes precedence over cookie. Cookie writes require an Origin in PUBLIC_ORIGINS; missing Origin is rejected. Implemented.
